question: Do you accept the completed defect-2D Stage A null-and-folding evidence after correction of all six implementation-review findings, successful execution of all eight frozen shape/twist cases, independent reconstruction, explicit seam-phase controls, and preservation of the four incompatible-representation stops, and authorize managed administrative closeout of that exact Stage A boundary?

options.summary: Accept Stage A and authorize its exact managed closeout.
options.consequence: Record Stage A as human-accepted, retain the defect-2D task as active without activating Stage B, synchronize and validate projections, create one non-amended closeout commit on dev, push it to the configured origin/dev upstream, verify remote identity, and stop.

options.summary: Do not accept or close out Stage A.
options.consequence: Retain the uncommitted Stage A evidence for bounded correction and do not commit, push, or activate another stage.

recommendation: ACCEPT_STAGE_A_AND_CLOSEOUT, because the exact authorized Stage A run completed within its resource envelope; all frozen folding, null-extraction, seam-phase, and structured-stop controls passed; the independent verifier reproduced every retained metric; all six implementation findings were corrected; eight execution-free behavioral tests and repository conformance gates pass; and the evidence is explicitly limited to synthetic numerical verification without a nonzero defect or material claim.
blocked_scope: Before this response, human acceptance and the managed Stage A closeout commit and push were blocked. Stage B and all later execution remain blocked in every case.
safe_scope: Retain and verify the exact Stage A evidence, synchronize its accepted status, commit and push only the in-scope closeout boundary on dev, verify upstream agreement, keep the current defect-2D task selected and active, and activate no successor stage.
human_response: stage A accepted, authorize managed closeout
authorized_scope: Record the exact completed Stage A null-and-folding evidence as human-accepted synthetic numerical verification; synchronize the applicable Task, manuscript, checksum, checkpoint, test-evidence, and Harness records; stage only this accepted boundary; create one non-amended commit on dev; push that exact commit to the already configured origin/dev upstream; verify remote commit identity; keep research-monograph.exercises.impurity.defect-2d active and selected; and stop without activating or implementing Stage B.
